---
name: grill-with-docs
description: Stress-test a plan against the existing Bahai Calendar domain model and documented decisions. Use when requirements or terminology are ambiguous before implementation.
---

<!-- absorbed from .github-old — verify still applies -->

Interview one question at a time, provide a recommended answer, and resolve questions by inspecting the codebase when evidence exists. Check `.github/memory/glossary.md`, `decisions.md`, and relevant source before asking.

Challenge overloaded terms such as calendar day, Badíʿ date, feast, holy day, fasting day, personal event, location, and sun time. Surface contradictions between stated behavior and code, and record only durable domain decisions in the appropriate documentation or memory file.
